_comment: Atlas Vector Search index for the `sops` collection. Create via the Atlas UI (Search > Create Index > JSON editor), the Atlas Admin API, or `npm run -w @ops-copilot/api db:atlas-indexes`. numDimensions (1536) must match EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS / the OpenAI embedding model. tenantId is a filter field so $vectorSearch can scope per tenant.
name: sop_vector_index
